lines: Sandeep Sambhaji Parab, role unknown, is selling 2,136,000 shares in the offer for sale, so money is coming to them.
Proceeds of ₹70.49 crore arrive on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026 per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are an estimate of ₹81.07 crore at offer price, so more value may remain for later conversations.
Gain is unknown because average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
